item.title: Rizal bettor wins ₱18-M Mega Lotto jackpot on March 2, 2026
item.description: MANILA, Philippines – A lone bettor won the jackpot prize of ₱18 million in the Mega Lotto 6/45 draw held on Monday, March 2, 2026. The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) announced that the lucky player bagged the ₱ 17,977,214.41 jackpot prize after correctly guessing the winning combination 12-25-45-40-33-27.
